adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` within `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new loop over `event.destinationCalendar` resolves a `credential` first from `this.calendarCredentials`, then conditionally from `prisma.credential.findUnique`. If neither path yields a usable credential (e.g., credential deleted, or DB row exists but `credentialFromDB.app?.slug` is falsy so the reconstructed `CredentialWithAppName` is never built), the code simply falls through without pushing any failure `EventResult` and without logging (only `if (credential) { ... createdEvents.push(...) }`). This means that destination is silently skipped and the caller receives no indication an event was not created for that destination.
